# MAAT

> MAAT (Multi-Agent Attention Terminal) is a local, zero-dependency, zero-telemetry dashboard over every AI coding agent you run (Claude Code, Codex). It routes your attention, shows the receipt behind every "done", and mines your own transcripts for spend: tokens, cost, step latency and alerts. Nothing leaves your machine; no LLM runs in the refresh loop.

MIT licensed. Node >= 18, no dependencies. Sources of truth: agent transcripts (activity, receipts, usage), your convention files (status), a local price table (cost).

## Docs

- [README](../README.md): what MAAT is, the problem, the trust constitution
- [AI install guide](./ai-install.md): written for coding agents; paste-in prompt for humans
- [Honest numbers](./HONEST-NUMBERS.md): measured limits, parser coverage, what is NOT verified
- [Companion instructions](../CLAUDE.md): onboarding interview, config schema, laws the companion must not break

## Key facts for agents

- Start: `node bin/maat.js` then open http://localhost:4178 (binds 127.0.0.1 only)
- Config: `~/.maat/config.json` (schema in CLAUDE.md); price overrides: `~/.maat/prices.json` (USD per MTok, `{"model-prefix": {"in": 5, "out": 25}}`)
- Spend honesty: unknown models show tokens but never an invented cost; the board says what % of tokens the cost figure covers
- Price updates: `node bin/maat.js --update-prices` (or the spend-panel button) — one on-demand fetch of OpenRouter's public feed for models seen in transcripts; hand-set rates are never overwritten; the refresh loop itself never touches the network
- Alerts: local rules in config (`alerts: [{name, metric, op, threshold, windowHours}]`), metrics incl. `eval_hits`, fire into the Needs-You queue, never email
- Trace waterfall: `/api/trace/<sessionId>` or the "trace" button on any session — full run as timed spans, on-demand re-parse, never in the loop
- Evals: deterministic code checks (`secret-leak`, `card-number`, `tool-thrash`, `pii-email` off by default), toggled via `evals: {"check-id": true|false}` in config; findings stored redacted
- MAAT never writes to Jira/Confluence/TestRail/anything remote; display only, forever
